breakdown.description: At the inlet, the specified phase volume fractions do not sum to 1 (e.g., alpha.air is set to 1.0 while alpha.catalyst is nonzero), which over-constrains the Euler–Euler phase fraction fields.
breakdown.reason: The Agent correctly identified that the phase volume fractions at the inlet must sum to 1. It explicitly set the inlet catalyst volume fraction to 0.01 and the inlet air volume fraction to 0.99, which correctly sums to 1.0, resolving the over-constrained condition.
